in_marathi.name: Jogaram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jogaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jogaram is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Joga' meaning divine grace and 'Ram' meaning God. This name symbolizes the blessings and grace of God in one's life.
